generator.input: one freely-licensed photograph (CC0, Tobi, via Wikimedia Commons), background removed in-pipeline by BiRefNet

cleanup: Cropped to a cylinder of radius 0.06 about the tower axis, removing the neighbouring skyline buildings the generator absorbed from the input photograph: 106,191 of 262,144 gaussians kept. No degenerate gaussians beyond that.
caveats: The hardest of the six to source: a mirrored glass prism in dense Manhattan is close to worst case for single-image generation, and four other photographs produced an unrecognisable slab.

Generated from a skyline photograph, so neighbouring buildings were absorbed into the object; cropped to a cylinder of radius 0.06 about the tower axis to remove them, which is why this object has 106k gaussians rather than 262k.
